articles.title: Germany news: Police probe suspected power station attacks
articles.description: Police are investigating after homemade projectiles were used to damage power lines in eastern Germany. This comes amid suspicion of sabotage at another power station in the west of the country. DW has more.

articles.title: New constitution in Guinea-Bissau will undermine democracy, opponents say
articles.description:
Referendum result means fewer seats in parliament and new rules on candidates, ahead of December elections
Guinea-Bissau voters have approved a new constitution, which critics say will undermine democracy, that significantly expands presidential powers ahead of elections due in December.
According to provisional results, 70% of voters approved sweeping changes in the tiny west African state’s first constitutional amendment since revisions that ended the one-party socialist state more than three decades ago.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ギニアビサウ新憲法、民主主義を損なうと野党が主張

articles.title: Almost half of world’s farmers poisoned by pesticides every year, experts find
articles.description:
Study reveals that pesticide poisoning kills 11,000 people each year, with India accounting for nearly 60% of fatalities
Almost half of the world’s farmers are poisoned by pesticides every single year, a study has found.
Using publicly available data from 2006-2023, the study, which was commissioned by Pesticide Action Network, found there to be an estimated 402-433m cases of unintentional acute pesticide poisoning of farmers and farm workers every year.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 世界の農家のほぼ半数が毎年農薬中毒に、専門家が指摘
articles.summary: ある研究によると、世界の農家のほぼ半数が毎年農薬中毒に罹患しており、年間1万1000人が死亡しているという。

articles.title: South African airline defends dramatic low-level flyby before rugby union clash
articles.description:
Cape Town stunt sparks major debate over safety risks

Airlink insists flyby conducted according to regulations

A pre-game stunt involving two passenger jets flying dramatically low over a stadium in South Africa drew huge cheers from the estimated crowd of 56,000 people, but also sparked a major debate over safety risks. The flyby by two Embraer jets, operated by the local airline Airlink, happened on Saturday before the second rugby union Test between South Africa and New Zealand in Cape Town.
The flight tracking service Flightradar24 estimated that the lead jet passed just 41-46 feet (12-14 metres) above the roof of Cape Town Stadium, with the crowd and the world’s top-ranked rugby teams below. The second jet, which was very close behind, flew through a cloud of pink dust that shot up from the stadium roof as part of the show.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 南アフリカの航空会社、ラグビー試合前の低空飛行を擁護
articles.summary: 南アフリカでラグビー試合前に旅客機がスタジアム上空を低空飛行したスタントが、安全性に関する大きな議論を巻き起こしている。

articles.title: Countries legally obliged to consider slavery reparations, says UN committee
articles.description:
Guidance says states must implement ‘comprehensive measures’ to address legacy of racial discrimination
A UN committee has said countries are legally obliged to consider reparations for the transatlantic slave trade and take other ⁠measures to address the enduring ⁠legacy of racial ​discrimination.
Guidance published on Monday by the committee on the elimination of racial discrimination (CERD) said the obligations arose from ⁠a legally binding 1965 convention on racial discrimination, not from the legal standards that existed when the slave trade took place.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 各国は奴隷制賠償を検討する法的義務があると国連委員会が発表
articles.summary: 国連委員会は、各国には大西洋奴隷貿易の賠償を検討し、人種差別の遺産に対処する法的義務があると発表した。

articles.title: Morocco not to blame for Ceuta border breach, says Spanish PM
articles.description:
Pedro Sánchez says two countries cooperating and accuses Israel and Russia of spreading fake news about migration
Spain’s prime minister, Pedro Sánchez, has said there is no evidence to suggest the Moroccan government was behind last month’s massive border crossing into Ceuta but accused Israel and Russia of spreading disinformation.
As many as 141 people are thought to have died trying to enter the Spanish enclave at the end of July. The influx of about 70,000 men, women and children unleashed a political crisis, a humanitarian emergency and reignited tensions within the EU over immigration.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: モロッコはセウタ国境侵犯の責任なし、スペイン首相が発言
articles.summary: スペインのサンチェス首相は、先月のセウタへの大規模な国境侵犯についてモロッコ政府の関与を示す証拠はないと述べた。

articles.title: Tumbler Ridge mass shooting victims file 30 new lawsuits against OpenAI
articles.description:
The company says it prioritizes safety, but suits allege its ChatGPT bot induced  shooter to carry out attack in Canada
OpenAI faces 30 new lawsuits filed on behalf of victims of the Tumbler Ridge mass shooting.
The suits, filed on Wednesday, allege the company’s ChatGPT chatbot induced the shooter to carry out the attack in rural Canada in February, in which eight people were killed and dozens more wounded – most of them children.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: タンブラーリッジ銃乱射事件の被害者がOpenAIに対し30件の新たな訴訟を提起

articles.title: Mark Carney tells US to ‘start being serious’ amid escalating trade war
articles.description:
Canadian PM is set to retaliate against tariffs levied by Donald Trump and criticized US officials over insults

US politics live – latest updates

Mark Carney has rebuked Donald Trump’s administration and urged officials in Washington to “start being serious” amid escalating trade tensions between the US and Canada.
Days before Canada is due to retaliate against Trump’s sweeping tariffs with its own duties on US goods, the Canadian prime minister criticized US officials for insulting his country. “It is beneath their office,” he said.
 Continue reading...

articles.title: MapQuest app reaches No 1 on US Apple list after defying Trump’s Lake Ontario order
articles.description:
Navigating app surpasses Google and Apple Maps on top-downloaded US chart after posting ‘we’re not changing it’
A pioneering online mapping app that defied Donald Trump by refusing to rename Lake Ontario has become the most in-demand navigation tool in the US.
MapQuest, which was openly dismissive of the president’s 27 August executive order directing federal agencies to refer to the smallest of the Great Lakes as “Lake America” amid a trade spat with Canada, leapfrogged rivals Google Maps and Apple Maps to top the most-downloaded list, as first reported by TechCrunch.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: MapQuestアプリ、トランプのオンタリオ湖改名命令に抵抗し米国Appleリストで1位に

articles.title: Echoes of cold war as US accused of meddling in another Brazilian election
articles.description:
Claims that Trump and Rubio are trying to influence result have parallels with CIA intervention 64 years ago
The year was 1962 and the Kennedy administration was desperate to swing Brazil’s congressional elections against its leftwing president, João Goulart, as a way of countering the supposed communist threat sweeping a region the US considered its back yard.
Historians say that in the lead-up to the vote, the CIA and the Department of State secretly channelled millions of dollars to opposition candidates and a group tasked with spreading rightwing propaganda and stirring up unrest.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 冷戦の再来、米国がブラジル選挙への干渉で非難される

articles.title: Trump suggests he is reviewing US support for UK over Falkland Islands
articles.description:
Comments signal president prepared to use dispute to push UK to raise defence spending and Nato contributions
Donald Trump has suggested he is reconsidering US support for Britain’s sovereignty over the Falkland Islands, in a move likely to strain the “special relationship” between Washington and London.
“I always review every position – that’s just one of many,” the US president told reporters in the White House, in response to a question about whether he was reviewing the US’s position over the South Atlantic islands, an archipelago whose status has long been disputed by Argentina, which claims sovereignty.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: トランプ、フォークランド諸島を巡る英国への米国の支持を見直すと示唆

articles.title: Who is Norway's new King Haakon VIII?
articles.description: Haakon becomes the king at a turbulent time for Norway's monarchy.
articles.titleJa: ノルウェー新国王ホーコン8世とは誰か？
articles.summary: ノルウェーの君主制にとって激動の時代に国王となったホーコン8世に焦点を当て、その背景を探る。

articles.title: Former Ecuadorian president imprisoned for corruption
articles.description: Lenín Moreno denies taking bribes from a Chinese firm to secure a contract to build a hydroelectric plant.
articles.titleJa: エクアドル元大統領、汚職で投獄
articles.summary: エクアドルのレニン・モレノ元大統領が、中国企業からの賄賂を受け取った容疑で投獄された。水力発電所の建設契約を巡る汚職事件。

articles.title: Colombia's new president approves extradition of rebel leaders to US
articles.description: It is a step towards ending a plan to stop violence by bringing rebel and criminal groups to the negotiating table.
articles.titleJa: コロンビア新大統領、反政府勢力指導者の米国への引き渡しを承認
articles.summary: コロンビア新大統領が、暴力終結計画の一環として、反政府勢力指導者の米国への引き渡しを承認。和平への一歩となる。

articles.title: Maradona's 'Hand of God' ball sells for £2.5m
articles.description: The football with which Diego Maradona scored his famous 'hand of God' goal in the 1986 World Cup quarter-final victory over England is sold at auction.
articles.titleJa: マラドーナの「神の手」ボールが250万ポンドで落札
articles.summary: ディエゴ・マラドーナが1986年ワールドカップで「神の手」ゴールを決めたボールが競売で250万ポンド（約4億円）で落札された。

articles.title: US sanctions more Cuban companies and officials
articles.description: An international socialist institute and Cuba's construction ministry are subject to the latest US sanctions, Marco Rubio announces.
articles.titleJa: 米国、キューバの企業と当局者に追加制裁
articles.summary: 米国がキューバの国際社会主義研究所と建設省に対し追加制裁を発表した。マルコ・ルビオ上院議員が表明。

articles.title: Peru earthquake damages buildings and causes power cuts
articles.description: A magnitude 6.7 earthquake struck the Ayacucho region on Thursday, the US Geological Survey says.
articles.titleJa: ペルー地震、建物に被害と停電発生
articles.summary: ペルーのアヤクチョ地域でマグニチュード6.7の地震が発生し、建物が損傷し停電も引き起こした。US地質調査所が発表。

articles.title: Panama Canal to cut number of ships passing through due to El Niño
articles.description: The crucial waterway's operator says low rainfall caused by the ocean pattern had led to the decision.
articles.titleJa: エルニーニョ現象によりパナマ運河の通航隻数を削減へ
articles.summary: エルニーニョ現象による少雨のため、パナマ運河が通航隻数を削減する決定を下した。世界的な物流に影響が出る見込み。

articles.title: Goals, records, tears ... Messi's most iconic moments
articles.description: As Lionel Messi retires from international football following the death of his father, BBC Sport looks back at some of his most iconic moments.
articles.titleJa: ゴール、記録、涙…メッシの最も象徴的な瞬間
articles.summary: 父の死を受け、国際サッカーからの引退を発表したリオネル・メッシ。BBCスポーツが彼の最も象徴的な瞬間を振り返る。

articles.title: The Argentine who wishes he could play for Wales
articles.description: Proud of his Welsh roots, Chile-based Argentine defender Jeremias James hopes for a rule change to help his international ambitions.
articles.titleJa: ウェールズ代表でのプレーを望むアルゼンチン人
articles.summary: ウェールズのルーツを持つチリ在住のアルゼンチン人DF、ジェレミアス・ジェームズが、国際的な野望のためルール改正を望んでいる。

articles.title: Livestreamer's murder raises questions over relations between Mexico's creators and cartels
articles.description: The murder of content creator César Gastélum on Tuesday raises questions about why influencers are coming under attack.
articles.titleJa: ライブ配信者の殺害、メキシコの人気クリエイターとカルテルの関係に疑問を投げかける
articles.summary: メキシコでコンテンツクリエイターのセサル・ガステルムが殺害され、インフルエンサーがなぜ狙われるのか、社会に疑問を呈している。

articles.title: 'My grandmother subjected my baby to female genital mutilation behind my back'
articles.description: In Colombia, where FGM is still practised by some members of an indigenous group, a landmark bill banning the practice has been enacted.
articles.titleJa: 「祖母が私の知らない間に娘に女性器切除を施した」
articles.summary: コロンビアで一部の先住民族がFGMを実践。この慣行を禁止する画期的な法案が制定されたが、未だ社会問題となっている。

articles.title: Venezuela’s earthquakes leave children facing trauma, displacement and food insecurity
articles.description: As families seek refuge, Venezuela’s youngest children grapple with fear, disrupted routines and the loss of basic nutritional security.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラの地震で子供たちがトラウマ、避難、食料不安に直面
articles.summary: ベネズエラの地震により、幼い子供たちは恐怖、日常生活の混乱、基本的な栄養保障の喪失という困難に直面している。家族は避難所を求めている。

articles.title: Amid political and economic pressure, Brazil sees a rise in land conflicts and the murders of Indigenous people
articles.description: Growing cases of violence against Indigenous people are linked to an impasse on the framework of rights and pressure against land demarcation, says the organization that advocates for Indigenous rights
articles.titleJa: 政治的・経済的圧力の中、ブラジルで土地紛争と先住民族殺害が増加
articles.summary: ブラジルでは政治的・経済的圧力が高まる中、先住民族に対する暴力が増加し、土地紛争や殺害事件が相次いでいる。権利の枠組みを巡る膠着状態が背景にある。

articles.title: ‘The Sigh of the Earth’: Fragments from communities overlooked after Venezuela’s earthquakes
articles.description: Combining documentary photography, personal testimony, and digital intervention, the project preserves the quieter aftermath of Venezuela’s underreported communities after the earthquakes.
articles.titleJa: 「大地の溜め息」：ベネズエラの地震後、見過ごされたコミュニティからの断片
articles.summary: ベネズエラの地震後、報道が少ない地域の静かな余波を、ドキュメンタリー写真や個人の証言で記録するプロジェクト。見過ごされたコミュニティの実情を伝える。

articles.title: More than a month after Venezuela’s earthquakes: ‘I’m not leaving here until my son is found’
articles.description: One month after the two earthquakes, thousands of relatives remain beside the collapsed buildings in La Guaira despite harsh conditions and insufficient support for search efforts.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラ地震から1か月以上：「息子が見つかるまでここを離れない」
articles.summary: ベネズエラ地震から1か月以上が経過し、ラ・グアイラでは数千人の親族が劣悪な環境と不十分な支援の中、倒壊した建物のそばで安否不明の家族を待ち続けている。

articles.title: In Brazil, court ruling sheds light on the story of an undocumented and stateless woman
articles.description: After 40 years without documents or an official identity, a woman born in Bolivia was able to regularize her immigration status and begin the process of recognition as a stateless person.
articles.titleJa: ブラジルで、無国籍の書類未保持女性の物語に判決が光を当てる
articles.summary: ブラジルで40年間書類なしで暮らしてきたボリビア生まれの女性が、裁判所の判決により在留資格を合法化し、無国籍者としての認定手続きを開始した。

articles.title: Venezuela is burning, and I’m forced to watch from afar
articles.description: From Mexico City, an exiled Venezuelan watches her homeland collapse in real time, confronting the helplessness of displacement, authoritarian neglect, and the unbearable distance between survival and home.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラは燃えている、そして私は遠くから見つめるしかない
articles.summary: メキシコ市に住むベネズエラ亡命者が、祖国の崩壊を遠くから見つめ、避難、権威主義的怠慢、そして故郷との耐え難い距離がもたらす無力感に直面している。

articles.title: Weaponizing citizenship: Silencing dissent in Nicaragua
articles.description: In this edition, we examine an authoritarian narrative making the case for denationalization in Nicaragua.
articles.titleJa: 市民権を武器化する：ニカラグアにおける反対意見の封殺
articles.summary: ニカラグアで、市民権を剥奪することで反対意見を封じ込める権威主義的な方針が取られている現状について検証する。

articles.title: How much will it take to rebuild Venezuela after the earthquakes?
articles.description: Early damage estimates vary widely, but all point to the same conclusion: rebuilding Venezuela will require unprecedented financial resources and long-term economic recovery efforts.
articles.titleJa: 地震後のベネズエラを再建するにはどれくらいの費用がかかるのか？
articles.summary: ベネズエラ地震後の復興には、前例のない財政資源と長期的な経済回復努力が必要であると、初期の被害推定は示している。

articles.title: From Mexico to Venezuela: A diaspora’s race to save lives
articles.description: From Mexico, Venezuelans mobilized within hours, building trusted networks to deliver aid and proving that solidarity can cross any border.
articles.titleJa: メキシコからベネズエラへ：ディアスポラによる命を救う競争
articles.summary: メキシコに住むベネズエラ人が数時間以内に動員し、信頼できるネットワークを構築して援助を提供。国境を越えた連帯を示した。

articles.title: How an AI research tool helped challenge support for police violence in Brazil
articles.description: In 2023, Brazil recorded 45,747 intentional violent deaths — among the highest rates in the world. Like many democracies, the country has long grappled with the issue of large-scale public support for state violence.
articles.titleJa: AI研究ツールがブラジルにおける警察の暴力への支持に異議を唱えるのにどう役立ったか
articles.summary: ブラジルで高い死亡率の原因となる警察の暴力への大規模な支持に対し、AI研究ツールが異議を唱える手助けをした事例が報告されている。

articles.title: Jailed HK activist Joshua Wong pleads guilty to foreign collusion
articles.description: Wong, 29, is already in prison on subversion charges under the controversial National Security Law.
articles.titleJa: 投獄された香港の活動家ジョシュア・ウォン、外国勢力との結託を認め有罪
articles.summary: 香港の著名な民主活動家ジョシュア・ウォンが、国家安全維持法下の外国勢力との結託容疑で有罪を認めた。彼は既に別の容疑で服役中。

articles.title: River water smashed into tunnel and chased me for 20 minutes, Nepal worker tells BBC
articles.description: Major efforts to rescue hydropower workers continue as Nepal's death toll exceeds 1,000.
articles.titleJa: 「川の水がトンネルを破壊し、20分間私を追いかけた」ネパールの作業員がBBCに語る
articles.summary: ネパールの洪水で、水力発電所の作業員がトンネル内で濁流に追われた体験を語った。ネパールの死者数は1,000人を超え、救出活動が続く。

articles.title: The final minutes before floodwater crashed through Nepal-China border
articles.description: More than 100 Indians are missing at a vital Nepal-China trade crossing after devastating Himalayan floods.
articles.titleJa: 洪水がネパール・中国国境を襲う直前の最後の数分間
articles.summary: ヒマラヤでの壊滅的な洪水がネパール・中国国境の重要な貿易地点を襲う直前の状況。100人以上のインド人が行方不明となっている。

articles.title: South Korea police officer admits to closing missing person cases to avoid work
articles.description: The officer falsely claimed he contacted missing persons and prematurely closed their cases on the South Korean holiday island of Jeju.
articles.titleJa: 韓国警察官、業務回避のため行方不明者捜索を打ち切ったことを認める
articles.summary: 韓国の警察官が、済州島で行方不明者のケースを業務を避けるために虚偽の報告で早期に終了させていたことを認めた。

articles.title: Why US troops have a history in this raucous Thai city
articles.description: The BBC's Jonathan Head looks at the historical echoes of US troops arriving in Pattaya, a beach resort famous for its racy bars.
articles.titleJa: 米軍がこの賑やかなタイの都市に歴史を持つ理由
articles.summary: BBCのジョナサン・ヘッドが、セクシーなバーで有名なタイのビーチリゾート、パタヤにおける米軍駐留の歴史的影響を探る。

articles.title: Orangutans in danger as wildfires blaze through Borneo
articles.description: Wildfires in Indonesia have destroyed part of the natural habitat of hundreds of orangutans, risking the survival of the species.
articles.titleJa: ボルネオ島で山火事が猛威を振るい、オランウータンが危険に
articles.summary: インドネシアでの山火事により、何百頭ものオランウータンの自然生息地の一部が破壊され、種の生存が脅かされている。

articles.title: Japan Inc is betting big on India as China risks deepen
articles.description: Japanese companies are doubling down on India amid a shrinking domestic market and rising risks in China.
articles.titleJa: 日本企業、中国リスクの深化を受けインドに大規模投資
articles.summary: 日本企業は、国内市場の縮小と中国でのリスク増大を受け、インドへの投資を強化している。

articles.title: 'I haven't lost my hope' - the search for missing loved ones
articles.description: Relatives of those still missing in the fatal floods in Nepal hold onto hope that their loved ones have survived.
articles.titleJa: 「希望は失っていない」－行方不明の愛する人の捜索
articles.summary: ネパールの壊滅的な洪水で、行方不明者の親族が愛する人の生存を信じ、希望を捨てずに捜索を続けている。

articles.title: 'Moonies' church leader jailed for two years over bribery offences
articles.description: Han Hak-ja, 83, gave South Korea's former first lady two Chanel bags and a diamond necklace, a court found.
articles.titleJa: 「統一教会」指導者、贈収賄罪で2年の実刑判決
articles.summary: 統一教会（世界平和統一家庭連合）の指導者、韓鶴子が韓国の元大統領夫人に高級品を贈与した贈収賄罪で2年の実刑判決を受けた。

articles.title: What will Sonia Gandhi's memoir reveal about India's most powerful dynasty?
articles.description: Sonia Gandhi’s memoir may finally answer questions about power, loss and the Gandhi family’s political legacy.
articles.titleJa: ソニア・ガンディーの回顧録はインドで最も強力な王朝について何を明らかにするのか？
articles.summary: ソニア・ガンディーの回顧録が、権力、喪失、そしてガンディー家の政治的遺産に関する長年の疑問に答えるかもしれないと注目されている。
